t.en: Use Cramer's rule to solve a system of equations with invertible coefficient matrix.
t.zh: 用克拉默法则求解系数矩阵可逆的方程组。

t.en: Another application of determinants is **Cramer's rule** for solving a system of equations. Recall that we can represent a system of linear equations in the form $A\vect{x}=\vect{b}$, where $\vect{x}$ is a vector of variables. Cramer's rule gives a formula for the solutions $\vect{x}$ in the special case that the coefficient matrix $A$ is a square invertible matrix. Note that Cramer's rule does not apply if you have a system of equations in which there is a different number of equations than variables (in other words, when $A$ is not square), or when $A$ is not invertible.
t.zh: 行列式的另一个应用是求解方程组的**克拉默法则**（Cramer's rule）。回忆一下，线性方程组可以写成 $A\vect{x}=\vect{b}$ 的形式，其中 $\vect{x}$ 是由变量组成的向量。在系数矩阵 $A$ 是方阵且可逆这一特殊情形下，克拉默法则给出了解 $\vect{x}$ 的公式。注意，如果方程组中方程的个数与变量的个数不同（也就是 $A$ 不是方阵），或者 $A$ 不可逆，克拉默法则就不适用。

t.zh: 其中 $A_i$ 是把 $A$ 的第 $i\th$ 列换成 $\vect{b}$ 后得到的矩阵。

Cramer's rule is sometimes useful in situations where row operations would be difficult to do. One such situation is when a system of equations involves functions rather than numbers, as in the following example.
t.zh: 在行变换难以进行的情形下，克拉默法则有时很有用。其中一种情形是方程组里出现的是函数而不是数，如下面的例子所示。

title.en: Using Cramer's rule for non-constant matrix
title.zh: 对非常数矩阵使用克拉默法则

t.en: Solve the following system of equations for $z$.
t.zh: 解下面的方程组，求出 $z$。

blocks.tex:
\left[\begin{array}{ccc}
      1 & 0 & 0 \\
      0 & e^{t}\cos t & e^{t}\sin t \\
      0 & -e^{t}\sin t & e^{t}\cos t
    \end{array}\right]
    \left[\begin{array}{c}
      x \\
      y \\
      z
    \end{array}\right]
    = \left[\begin{array}{c}
      1 \\
      t \\
      t^2
    \end{array}\right].

t.en: True or false? “Cramer's rule is useful for finding solutions to systems of linear equations in which there is an infinite set of solutions.”
t.zh: 判断对错：“克拉默法则可用于求解有无穷多个解的线性方程组。”

t.en: False. Cramer's rule only works when the coefficient matrix is invertible. In these cases, the solution is always unique.
t.zh: 错。克拉默法则只在系数矩阵可逆时适用。在这些情形下，解总是唯一的。
